Avatar Capital Partners (ACP), an Asia-based alternative asset management platform, has announced the first close of Fund II, securing $156 million in commitments, along with a new strategic partnership with GCM Grosvenor and the Teacher Retirement System of Texas (TRS). As part of the partnership, GCM Grosvenor’s real estate practice, a leading middle-market platform builder and GP stakes investor, and TRS will serve as anchor investors in Fund II and strategic partners supporting ACP’s institutional expansion. These milestones underscore strong institutional support for ACP’s Japan living sector strategy and mark a significant step in the firm’s evolution as an institutional investment platform.
